notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If an opponent has at least four cards in hand, this combo nets infinite red mana.
You may also choose both of Jeska's Will modes when casting it if you control a commander.
